sectionDom: main > div.section[data-section-status], inline display:none until loaded;
default content runs are wrapped in div.default-content-wrapper
cellNormalization: wrapTextNodes: a cell whose first element is not P/PRE/UL/OL/PICTURE/TABLE/H1-6
(or a picture followed by more) is folded into one
buttonizationRule: decorateButtons(main): p a[href] alone in its paragraph, no , not a URL-display link,
inside <strong> (primary), <em> (secondary) or both (accent); sets a.title too
fragments: runs decorateMain (icons, auto-blocks, sections, blocks, buttons) + loadSections
icons: :name: arrives as span.icon.icon-<name> (case preserved); decorateIcons appends
notes.sectionMetadata: rendered server-side; the client runtime has no section-metadata step
emptySection:
the pipeline consumes the metadata block and leaves an empty
section
notes.bodyGate: body { display: none } + body.appear { display: block } (loadEager)
chromeReservation: header { height: var(--nav-height) }; header .header / footer .footer hidden
fonts: styles/fonts.css via loadFonts(): eager on desktop (>= 900px) or with the
fonts-loaded session flag, always in loadLazy
notes.autoBlocks: /fragments/ links load as fragments; a[href*="/widgets/"] become widget blocks
